notes.total_pipeline_duration_seconds: Wall-clock time for the extraction run, from loading project data through export of experiment snapshots. Includes time spent answering the interactive config wizard when no config file is provided.

stage_durations_seconds.annotation_conversion: Load and normalise the gold-standard import into documents and attributes.
stage_durations_seconds.prompt_population: Attach custom prompts from the project prompt CSV. Zero if skipped.
stage_durations_seconds.document_preparation: Load linked documents from cache or parse/read PDF and markdown sources. See per_document.parsing_seconds.
stage_durations_seconds.llm_extraction: LLM extraction for each document. See per_document.llm_call_seconds.
stage_durations_seconds.artifact_export: Write prompts snapshot, config snapshot, and this metadata file.

per_document.parsing_seconds: Parse/read time during document preparation; null when parsing_skipped is true.
per_document.parsing_skipped: True when full text came from cache and was not parsed this run.
per_document.llm_call_seconds: Wall-clock time for the LLM request, including local prompt setup.
